Chapter 890: Chapter 25: The Terrifying Merit Points Settlement (Please Subscribe)

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan, in his true form, sits cross-legged.

Centered around him, all of space-time continuously integrates and weaves, as if worlds are being born and annihilated.

This is a reflection of the understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule reaching a certain height.

Since ninety years ago, after the Insect Race’s Myriad Transformation Queen hinted at some secrets,

Lin Yuan’s true form has been permanently residing in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which is considered absolutely safe, beyond the reach even of the twelfth rank ultimate beings who are unable to lock onto its precise coordinates.

With part of his power revealed, Lin Yuan naturally needed to consider whether the twelfth rank ultimates might strike at him.

The extremely powerful Xia Qin did invite Lin Yuan to the Central Star Domain, where numerous Clan Suppression Weapons are in place,

Which is also considered safe enough.

But Lin Yuan still prefers the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

As for the Milky Way Main Star? Just send a random incarnation to hold the fort.

With Lin Yuan’s current mental will and his understanding of the rules,

Even a randomly condensed incarnation could exhibit nearly the strength of an Eleventh Rank Peak.

In some respects, Lin Yuan could be considered a ‘weakened version’ of the twelfth rank ultimate.

Before stepping into the twelfth rank, Lin Yuan set a requirement for himself.

That is, the true form should avoid leaving the Xuanhuang Secret Realm as much as possible.

For any external affairs, let the Taiyang and Taiyin Primordial Spirits handle them.

Additionally, there are a large number of incarnations available.

…

“Ninety years and I have raised thirty-six pillar-level fusion rules to the Seventh Realm, which is the twelfth rank level, but what about the Spacetime Fusion Rule?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

If the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm is divided into four levels: early, middle, late, and peak,

Then Lin Yuan’s current understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule would be at the middle level, still some distance from the late stage.

This is already extremely exaggerated.

Even most twelfth rank ultimates are only at early to mid-stage in their understanding of the Spacetime Fusion Rule, with very few reaching the late or peak of the Sixth Realm.

And the Seventh Realm understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule? So far, Lin Yuan has not heard of any twelfth rank ultimate reaching it.

Even mighty beings like Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master who are in the Chaos Realm are only at the Ninth Realm in their understanding of the Spacetime Fusion Rule.

“Is it still impossible for me to break through the seventh layer of the Magic Jade Tower with my current understanding of the rules?”

Lin Yuan felt somewhat helpless; he was able to breach one-third of the Black Tower’s seventh layer at the tenth rank. Now at the eleventh rank and after cultivating for a hundred or so years, he still was stuck at the final part of the seventh layer.

“It seems that compared to true twelfth rank beings, I still have a significant gap.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that the nine-layer Black Tower built by the Demonic Jade Tower Master begins to be a challenge only twelve rank beings may hope to overcome starting from the seventh layer.

…

“Inner world…”

The consciousness avatar of Lin Yuan descends into his inner world, in ninety years besides the improvement in rule comprehension, the inner world also received a significant boost.

After undergoing the Chaos Void Origin Infusion for the second time, Lin Yuan gained benefits tantamount to those of an Eleventh Rank Perfect assaulting the ultimate level; however, the vast majority of the Chaos Void Origin remained dormant deep within the inner world.

Lin Yuan has not yet stepped into the twelfth rank, and his life essence has not realized a significant leap, so he cannot absorb all the Chaos Void Origin within a short period of time.

But as time goes on, the dormant Chaos Void Origin within the inner world is gradually being absorbed.

This has led to—

Lin Yuan’s inner world, after just ninety years, has expanded to over nine hundred billion miles in circumference.

When Lin Yuan first entered the eleventh rank, his inner world was only six hundred billion miles in circumference. Over a mere hundred years or so, it has reached over nine hundred billion miles.

An increase of over three hundred billion miles in circumference, amounting to how many millions of Eleventh Rank Perfect beings’ inner worlds?

“Theoretically, if I absorb all the dormant Chaos Void Origin, my inner world will reach the threshold of the twelfth rank, which is several tens of thousands of light-years?”

“Then, will my inner world slowly metamorphose into its own universe?”

Lin Yuan pondered.

But that would take an exceedingly long time, several tens of thousands of light-years from several tens of millions of miles? The gap is too wide.

Moreover, the inner world is limited by the essence of life, as long as Lin Yuan does not step into the twelfth rank, there might be an upper limit.

“The Xuanhuang Physique… It probably won’t be long before it reaches Eleventh Rank Perfect,” Lin Yuan felt his physical body thoroughly, a satisfied smile emerging on his face.

Over the past ninety years, Lin Yuan has successively completed transactions with other peak clan powers, trading away more than six hundred of the strongest weapons for a seasworthy amount of cultivation resources.

More than eighty years ago, Lin Yuan officially brought the “Xuanhuang Physique” to a great level of accomplishment.

Now, he is just steps away from the Eleventh Rank Perfect.

And once the “Xuanhuang Physique” reaches Eleventh Rank Perfect, in terms of pure physical body, Lin Yuan will be comparable to the physical bodies of the twelfth rank ultimates.

“An Eleventh Rank Perfect ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ would require the strength of all the major peak clans to achieve, how should I cultivate the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ to the twelfth rank perfect…”

Lin Yuan was somewhat worried.

A normal twelfth rank perfect “Xuanhuang Physique” allows the cultivator to rely solely on the physical body to contend with the pinnacle of the ‘Dao Manifestation’ realm.

This is also why the twelfth rank “Xuanhuang Physique” is said to be able to easily traverse the cataclysms of the universe’s destruction.

But Lin Yuan’s physical starting point is too high, once he cultivates to the twelfth rank and wishes to continue cultivating the “Xuanhuang Physique” to twelfth rank perfect, the demand for resources will probably far exceed that of a normal twelfth rank perfect.

A normal twelfth rank perfect “Xuanhuang Physique” has reached the point where it can’t be cultivated even by pouring the resources of an entire universe.
